senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; שְׁמֹנֶה)eighth; one eighth. Sifra Sh’mini, Milluim, beg. ש׳ למנין the eighth day in the order of counting (from the initiation of the priests); ש׳ לחדש the eighth day of the month. Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵃ bot.; Y. Pes. X, 37ᶜ bot. חצי שמינית half an eighth (of a Log); a. v. fr.—Esp. שמיני, or ש׳ של חג the eighth day of the Succoth festival.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 47a:4">Succ. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>אומרים זמן בש׳ של חג</he> we recite the benediction for the entrance of a festival (<cite ref="G00537"><he>זְמָן</he></cite>) on the eighth day &c.
Ib., a. fr. ש׳ רגל וכ׳ the eighth day is a festival for itself; a. fr.—Pl. fem. שְׁמִינִיּוֹת.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1048:7">Yalk. Esth. 1048</cite> <he>ארבעים ש׳</he> (not <cite ref="U01524"><he>שמציות</he></cite>) forty eighths (of a Kab), v. <cite ref="V00229"><he>תּוֹמָן</he></cite>.
